field_of_view_deg: 92 horizontal, 45 vertical (1080p); 56 horizontal, 29 vertical (720p with F34/F44)
features: Modular AXIS F-Series sensor unit — requires a separate AXIS F34/F41/F44 Main Unit; power, storage, codecs and streaming are provided by the main unit
Pinhole lens for extremely discreet indoor surveillance (ATMs, stores, elevators)
WDR – Forensic Capture (with AXIS F41/F44 Main Unit)
Pre-mounted 3 m or 12 m cable (12 m version weighs 328 g)
release_notes: Specs per official Axis datasheet (ds_f1025_t10061991_en_2010.pdf). Sensor unit only: power, storage, codecs, protocols and RTSP come from the paired AXIS F-series main unit, so no configs are recorded.
